results.title: Share link selects verses
results.checks: ?v=16-18 opens with John 3:16–18 selected and the verse toolbar's Highlight naming them

results.title: Share a verse: link and embed code
results.checks: Select 3:16 → Share opens the old reader's Share window; Share a link copies a link ending in ?v=16; Embed gives an iframe of the compact reader, dark when Dark is chosen

results.title: The session's Shared tab
results.checks: The host starts a session in John 3 and a guest joins: that tab is marked Shared with the people on it (Host first); its ⋮ has Session settings, Share session and Open chat instead of Save. A new tab moved to Romans 8 does not move the session (the guest stays in John 3). Closing the Shared tab from its ⋮ ends the session for the guest
results.note: the session's tab showed Shared with its people and the session menu; another tab left the guest in John 3; closing the tab ended it

results.title: Start and share a session from Share
results.checks: Signed in, the chapter's Share → Start and share session starts one and copies its link (with the session and its code); Share again offers Share current session and the session's QR card; tapping the code opens a large Scan to join view
results.note: Share started a session and copied its link; Share again offered Share current session and the QR, whose large view opened

results.title: Session QR code
results.checks: Signed in: start a session → QR code shows a scannable picture of the share link, with Save image; tapping it opens a large Scan to join view, Esc closes it
results.note: QR 13 KB PNG with Save image; tapped, a 296px Scan to join view

results.title: The chapter header's actions
results.checks: At the top right of the chapter, in the old reader's order: ☆ Save chapter fills when tapped, Bookmark, Discover opens the Discover pane, Share opens the Share dialog with the chapter's link, and the orange Listen plays the recording and turns into Pause
results.note: header: Save chapter · Bookmark this chapter · Discover · Share · Listen; Save filled and cleared; Discover opened its pane; Share opened the dialog; Listen played and paused
